def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    fund_value = 100_000_000
    current_equity_allocation = 0.80
    target_equity_allocation = 0.60
    equity_beta = 1.20
    futures_beta = 0.95
    index_value = 1_200
    contract_multiplier = 250

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    equity_exposure_to_adjust = (
        fund_value
        * (current_equity_allocation - target_equity_allocation)
        * equity_beta
    )
    futures_contract_value = index_value * contract_multiplier
    beta_adjusted_futures_value = futures_contract_value * futures_beta

    number_of_contracts = equity_exposure_to_adjust / beta_adjusted_futures_value

    # return answer
    return round(number_of_contracts, 3)
